title: rel0-3-1: Sidecar 0.3.1 mods (default, recommended)
description: The mods for Sidecar 0.3.1: everything in rel0-3-0, plus the fix that makes send FX follow a kit switch at once. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.3.1.elemod (sha256 a203db27...3df3c). Goes with Sidecar 0.3.1 on the Pi.
